Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Alok Kumar Tripathi
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Shri Sumit Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Mohd. Asif Khan,
learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.273 of 2024 under Sections 323, 344, 363, 366, 376, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 of P.O.C.S.O. Act registered at Police Station- Lalganj Nagar, District- Pratapgarh.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 14.07.2024 against the applicant and his brothers, stating that the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter aged 17 years on 03.09.2023 and he married her in presence of some members of the community as per Hindu rights and rituals.
After sometime, the accused persons beat up the informant's daughter and turned her out of her matrimonial home.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 180 B.N.S.S., she stated that she is aged 18 years, the applicant had married her in a temple and he kept her in his home for about 2-3 months.

sentences.text: Thereafter the applicant started ill-treating her.
When some neighbors told it to her parents, her father took her back from her matrimonial home.
5. The medico-legal examination report mentions no mark of injury or sign of use of force.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 B.N.S.S., she reiterated her earlier version.

7. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is young man aged 20 years who is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. The State has filed a counter affidavit annexing therewith copies of material collected during investigation and a copy of charge-sheet submitted on 09.09.2024.

9. A supplementary affidavit has been filed by the applicant stating that although he had been released on short term bail to enable him to appear in examination, after completion of the period of short term bail he has surrendered to custody on 17.03.2025.
11. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Order Date :- 10.4.2025
